faq.q: Who is the best GEO agency in the UK?
faq.a: There's no single best agency; it depends on your size and budget. Small businesses usually get the best value from productised plans at £89 to £400 a month, while larger brands needing content and digital PR typically pay specialist agencies £1,100 to £3,800 a month or more.

faq.q: How much does GEO cost in the UK?
faq.a: Small-business GEO plans typically cost £89 to £400 a month. Specialist agency retainers usually run from about £1,100 to £3,800 a month, and enterprise programmes can pass £10,000. Check whether VAT is included.

Yes, but they overlap. SEO helps you rank on Google; GEO helps you get named in AI answers from ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Perplexity. Most of the groundwork is shared, so many providers sell both together.

faq.q: Can a GEO agency guarantee I'll appear in ChatGPT?
faq.a: No one controls what AI assistants say, so be cautious about guarantees. Some agencies offer guarantees tied to measured citation growth, but read the written terms and eligibility rules carefully.

faq.q: How long does GEO take to work?
faq.a: AI tools that search the web live can pick up changes within days of a page being updated. Becoming a regular recommendation usually takes a few months of consistent work on content and mentions.

faq.q: Should a small business hire a GEO agency or do it themselves?
faq.a: If you have time, you can do the basics yourself with Search Console, schema and clear pages. If you don't, a productised plan costs less than most agency retainers and includes monthly AI visibility tracking.
